intro: Need space to think as well as a spot for all your files, papers, and that ever-growing to-do list? The T-9 is designed for both—giving you room to work, store, and stay organised effortlessly.

features.title: Room to work, room to grow
features.text: With a 4.3-foot-wide tabletop, you’ll have all the space you need to spread out and get things done without feeling cramped.

features.title: Smart storage on both sides
features.text: Two storage units keep your files, papers, and office essentials neatly organized—so everything is within arm’s reach.

features.title: Stay comfortable, work better
features.text: A built-in footrest adds comfort and support, letting you stretch out and relax even during long work hours.

features.title: Effortless cleaning, everyday ease
features.text: Hanging drawers allow for easy floor cleaning, keeping your workspace fresh and dust-free with minimal effort.

features.title: Strong, sturdy, and made to last
features.text: Crafted with a durable metal understructure, the T-9 is built for years of reliable use.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Table T 9 Office Desk
